name: OTEL Observability — otelCollector Capability and Telemetry Push
description: Verifies the vendor device's OTEL collector actively pushes telemetry to the CTT's OTLP HTTP receiver (port 4318) and Prometheus Remote Write endpoint (port 9090). PRECONDITION: configure the device's OTEL collector to push to http://<ctt-host>:4318 (OTLP HTTP) and http://<ctt-host>:9090/api/v1/write (Prometheus Remote Write) before running this scenario. Matches the sandbox observability architecture: device → Jaeger OTLP / Prometheus Remote Write → WFM observability stack.

steps.name: Wait for Device OTEL Collector to Push Telemetry (traces or metrics)
Confirm Prometheus Remote Write Also Received
